title: Jammy Crisp Irish Lamb Stew
description: A comforting Irish dish featuring tender lamb, sweet and tangy flavors from tamarind pulp and yuzu-cure, all in a low-calorie friendly package.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large Dutch oven, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat.
Add the lamb cubes and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onions, carrots, potatoes, and celery, and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 10 minutes.
Add the tamarind pulp, yuzu-cure, and low-sodium chicken broth, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then cover the Dutch oven and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake for 2 hours, or until the lamb is tender and the sauce has thickened.
Remove the stew from the oven and let it cool slightly before serving.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
